messages.content:
You are an expert JavaScript programmer. Write a single JavaScript function that creates a voice-controlled racing game.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Function takes a canvas ID parameter (canvas will be 500x500px)
- Top-down racing track with curves and obstacles
- Car speed controlled by microphone volume (louder = faster)
- Web Audio API for microphone access with graceful permission handling
- Visual volume meter showing microphone input level
- Lap timing system with personal best tracking
- Crash detection with realistic physics (speed affects severity)
- "Start Race" button and race completion celebration
- Mute/unmute toggle for testing
- Smooth 60 FPS performance
- No external libraries beyond Web Audio API

OUTPUT: Valid JavaScript code only. No explanatory text, comments outside code, or markdown formatting.

<script>
function createVoiceControlledRaceGame(canvasId){
    const canvas=document.getElementById(canvasId);
    const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
    canvas.width=500; canvas.height=500;
    const cx=250, cy=250;
    const trackRadius=200, innerRadius=150;
    const obstacles=[{t:0.25,r:20,cx:cx+trackRadius*Math.cos(Math.PI/2),cy:cy+trackRadius*Math.sin(Math.PI/2)},
                     {t:0.55,r:15,cx:cx+trackRadius*Math.cos(0),cy:cy+trackRadius*Math.sin(0)},
                     {t:0.75,r:18,cx:cx+trackRadius*Math.cos(-Math.PI/2),cy:cy+trackRadius*Math.sin(-Math.PI/2)}];
    const carSize=10;
    let t=0;
    let speed=0;
    let isRunning=false;
    let lapCount=0;
    let lapStartTime=0;
    let lapTimes=[];
    let bestLap=parseFloat(localStorage.getItem('VoiceRaceBest_'+canvasId))||Infinity;
    let audioCtx=null;
    let analyser=null;
    let dataArray=null;
    let muted=false;
    let crashTimer=0;
    const startBtn=document.createElement('button');
    startBtn.textContent='Start Race';
    const muteBtn=document.createElement('button');
    muteBtn.textContent='Mute';
    const infoDiv=document.createElement('div');
    document.body.append(startBtn,muteBtn,infoDiv);
    function initAudio(){
        if(muted)return;
        navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:true}).then(stream=>{
            if(audioCtx)audioCtx.close();
            audioCtx=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
            const source=audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
            analyser=audioCtx.createAnalyser();
            analyser.fftSize=512;
            dataArray=new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
            source.connect(analyser);
        }).catch(err=>{infoDiv.textContent='Microphone access denied';});
    }
    function getVolume(){
        if(!analyser)return 0;
        analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
        let sum=0;
        for(let v of dataArray)sum+=v;
        return sum/dataArray.length/255;
    }
    function update(){
        if(isRunning && crashTimer<=0){
            const vol=getVolume();
            speed=vol*4+0.5;
            t+=speed/1000; t%=1;
            if(t<0.001 && !isRunning){}else{
                if(t<0.001 && lapCount>0){ // lap completed
                    const lapTime=Date.now()-lapStartTime;
                    lapTimes.push(lapTime);
                    if(lapTime<bestLap){bestLap=lapTime;localStorage.setItem('VoiceRaceBest_'+canvasId,bestLap);}
                }
            }
        }else{
            speed=0;
        }
        if(crashTimer>0)crashTimer--;
        draw();
        requestAnimationFrame(update);
    }
    function drawTrack(){
        ctx.strokeStyle='#444';
        ctx.lineWidth=20;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(cx,cy,trackRadius,0,2*Math.PI);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.lineWidth=30;
        ctx.strokeStyle='#222';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(cx,cy,innerRadius,0,2*Math.PI);
        ctx.stroke();
        obstacles.forEach(o=>{
            ctx.fillStyle='#A00';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(o.cx,o.cy,o.r,0,2*Math.PI);
            ctx.fill();
        });
    }
    function drawCar(){
        const rad=2*Math.PI*t;
        const x= cx+trackRadius*Math.cos(rad);
        const y= cy+trackRadius*Math.sin(rad);
        const angle=rad;
        if(crashTimer>0){speed=0;}
        ctx.fillStyle='#0F0';
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(x,y);
        ctx.rotate(angle);
        ctx.fillRect(-carSize/2,-carSize/2,carSize,carSize);
        ctx.restore();
        // crash detection
        obstacles.forEach(o=>{
            const d=Math.hypot(x-o.cx,y-o.cy);
            if(d<carSize+o.r && crashTimer===0){
                crashTimer=30;
            }
        });
    }
    function drawMeter(){
        const vol=getVolume()*100;
        ctx.fillStyle='#888';
        ctx.fillRect(10,470,480,20);
        ctx.fillStyle='#0FF';
        ctx.fillRect(10,470,vol*4.8,20);
    }
    function drawStats(){
        ctx.font='14px Arial';
        ctx.fillStyle='#FFF';
        ctx.fillText('Lap: '+(lapCount+1),10,20);
        ctx.fillText('Best: '+(bestLap===Infinity?'--':(bestLap/1000).toFixed(2))+'s',10,40);
        ctx.fillText('Muted: '+(muted?'Yes':'No'),10,60);
        ctx.fillText('Speed: '+speed.toFixed(2),10,80);
        if(crashTimer>0){
            ctx.font='30px Arial';
            ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,0,0,0.7)';
            ctx.fillText('Crashed!',200,250);
        }
    }
    function draw(){
        ctx.clearRect(0,0,500,500);
        drawTrack();
        drawCar();
        drawMeter();
        drawStats();
    }
    startBtn.onclick=function(){
        if(isRunning)return;
        isRunning=true;
        lapStartTime=Date.now();
        lapCount++;
        if(!audioCtx){initAudio();}
    };
    muteBtn.onclick=function(){
        muted=!muted;
        muteBtn.textContent=muted?'Unmute':'Mute';
        if(muted && audioCtx){audioCtx.close();audioCtx=null;}
        if(!muted && isRunning && !audioCtx){initAudio();}
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(update);
}
</script>
